title: Proton pump inhibitors therapy and risk of Clostridium difficile infection: systematic review and meta-analysis
authors: Trifan A, Stanciu C, Girleanu I, Stoica OC, Singeap AM, Maxim R, et al.
population: 56 observational studies (40 case-control, 16 cohort) in adults, searched January 1990 to March 2017
authorConflicts: The authors deny any conflict of interest.
result: PPI users against non-users: pooled OR for C. difficile infection 1.99 (95% CI 1.73 to 2.30); case-control 2.00 (1.68 to 2.38), cohort 1.98 (1.51 to 2.59); adjusted 1.95 (1.67 to 2.27); age 65 or older 1.93 (1.40 to 2.68), younger 2.06 (1.11 to 3.81). Heterogeneity I2 85.4%. The abstract reports funnel-plot asymmetry (P = 0.002) indicating publication bias, whereas the results section reports a non-significant Egger test (Z = 0.3699, P = 0.711).
